title: File 007
subtitle: What SPECTRE leaked. Read it before you destroy it.

eras.title: Six actors, one licence
items: Six actors, more than 60 years, 25 official films.
Sean Connery: the one who invented it all.
Roger Moore: the one with the humor and the raised eyebrow.
Timothy Dalton: the darkest one, the most faithful to the books.
Pierce Brosnan: the 90s one, gadgets and technology.
Daniel Craig: the one who broke him and made him human.

who.title: Who is Bond?
items: Commander in the British Royal Navy.
MI6 agent. The "00" means he has a licence to kill.
Lives in a flat in Chelsea, London.
Takes his martini shaken, not stirred.

firstBook.title: The first book and the woman who changed him
items: Ian Fleming published Casino Royale in 1953. That's where Bond was born.
In 2006 the same story was used to reboot the series with Daniel Craig.
Vesper Lynd, the love of Bond's life, betrayed him. That's why Bond trusts no one.

villains.title: The rogues' gallery
items: Goldfinger (Goldfinger): obsessed with gold.
Oddjob (Goldfinger): a lethal hat.
Blofeld (several films): head of SPECTRE, always with a white cat.
Jaws (The Spy Who Loved Me, Moonraker): a giant with steel teeth.
Le Chiffre (Casino Royale): weeps blood.
Raoul Silva (Skyfall): a former MI6 agent.

origin.title: The origin
items: Bond is Scottish on his father's side.
His parents died in a climbing accident when he was a child.
Skyfall was his childhood home. Bond never went back… until that night.
origin.quote: That's why he is who he is: someone who lost everything early and learned not to hold on to anything.

birthplace.title: Where it all began
items: Ian Fleming wrote every Bond novel at his home in Jamaica, called Goldeneye.
Dr. No (1962) was the first film, starring Sean Connery.
That film was the first to say "Bond. James Bond."
Bond also ran as a newspaper comic strip from 1958.
